title: merchant.kyc_approved.v1
description: The KYC/KYB vendor returned an approval and the merchant moved KYC_PENDING -> KYC_APPROVED. Published by Onboarding (BC-3) on pp.merchants.merchant.v1, keyed by merchant_id. This payload carries the vendor's CASE REFERENCE and an object-storage pointer to the evidence - never the evidence itself, and never personal data. The evidence lives under Object Lock in the tenant's residency region and is retained at least five years under the AML legal-obligation basis.

kycReference.description: Vendor case reference only. A pointer, never the decision evidence and never PII.

provider.description: Vendor code. Carried so a vendor-specific incident can be scoped to the merchants it touched.

decidedAt.description: The vendor's decision time, not ours. Distinct from the envelope `time`, which is when we recorded it.

principalsVerified.description: How many merchant principals the vendor verified.

ubosVerified.description: Of those, how many were ultimate beneficial owners. At least one is required before onboarding may proceed.

evidenceRef.description: Object-storage URI under Object Lock. NOT the evidence itself - a consumer that needs the evidence must be separately authorized to read it.

refreshDueAt.description: When periodic KYC refresh falls due, per the compliance policy's refresh interval. Absent when the policy sets no refresh.
